name: Structured Clinical History
mechanism: Elicit the sequence, context and functional effects of symptoms through a repeatable interview
operating_requirement: Trained listener, accessible communication, privacy and retained observations
consequence: Improve the clinical question before selecting tests or treatments

name: Physical Percussion Examination
mechanism: Compare sounds produced by examined body regions to infer selected underlying changes
operating_requirement: Practiced examiner and appropriate examination setting
consequence: Add bounded physical findings without powered instruments

name: Clinical Palpation Mapping
mechanism: Systematically compare accessible tissue and movement findings with recorded landmarks
operating_requirement: Trained examiner, patient agreement and consistent observation practice
consequence: Localize selected findings while preserving limits of touch-based inference

name: Respiratory Rate Assessment
mechanism: Observe respiratory frequency and effort over a defined interval in context
operating_requirement: Competent observer, time reference and repeat assessment
consequence: Recognize changes that support further assessment without diagnosing from one number

name: Clinical Visual Acuity Testing
mechanism: Measure resolved visual detail using standardized targets and test conditions
operating_requirement: Suitable targets, measured viewing setup and trained assessment
consequence: Identify measured vision limitations and guide appropriate referral

name: Clinical Hearing Threshold Testing
mechanism: Compare responses to calibrated sound presentations under controlled conditions
operating_requirement: Calibrated sound equipment, quiet setting and qualified examiner
consequence: Characterize hearing thresholds for support or investigation

name: Neurological Function Examination
mechanism: Compare defined sensory, movement and response findings across repeated examinations
operating_requirement: Qualified examiner, suitable aids and accessible patient communication
consequence: Identify patterns requiring targeted investigation without automatic localization certainty

name: Clinical Functional Status Scales
mechanism: Use reproducible task-based measures of function with recorded context
operating_requirement: Validated assessment tasks, trained observers and accessible testing
consequence: Track meaningful change in daily function separately from laboratory markers

name: Electrocardiographic Recording
mechanism: Record time-varying electrical activity from the heart through qualified surface measurements
operating_requirement: Calibrated recorder, electrodes, power and clinical interpretation
consequence: Add electrical rhythm evidence without equating every trace change with disease

name: Electroencephalographic Recording
mechanism: Record selected scalp electrical activity and distinguish artifacts from interpretable patterns
operating_requirement: Qualified amplifier, electrodes, controlled acquisition and specialist review
consequence: Support defined neurological questions with bounded signal evidence

name: Spirometric Testing
mechanism: Measure reproducible forced respiratory volume and flow under qualified test conditions
operating_requirement: Calibrated flow equipment, hygienic consumables and trained coaching
consequence: Characterize selected ventilatory limitations rather than all respiratory disease

name: Pulse Oximetric Sensing
mechanism: Estimate arterial oxygen saturation from calibrated pulsatile optical measurements
operating_requirement: Qualified optical sensor, power, signal-quality checks and clinical context
consequence: Provide bounded noninvasive oxygenation evidence with known interference limits

name: Blood Gas Analysis
mechanism: Measure selected dissolved gases and acid-base properties in appropriately handled blood specimens
operating_requirement: Validated analyzer, reagents, controlled sampling and laboratory staff
consequence: Support assessment of gas exchange and metabolic disturbance with handling-dependent accuracy

name: Clinical Electrolyte Sensing
mechanism: Measure selected ionic activity with calibrated selective sensing methods
operating_requirement: Qualified electrodes, reference materials, specimens and laboratory quality controls
consequence: Guide interpretation of defined electrolyte disturbances

name: Enzymatic Glucose Assays
mechanism: Couple a glucose-specific biochemical reaction to a calibrated measurable signal
operating_requirement: Validated reagent or sensor supply, quality controls and trained interpretation
consequence: Measure glucose for an indicated clinical question without inferring all metabolic health

name: Continuous Glucose Monitoring
mechanism: Track qualified interstitial glucose signals over time with calibration and fault handling
operating_requirement: Approved sensor system, power, replacement supplies and patient support
consequence: Provide trend evidence with signal lag and device limitations

name: Clinical Immunoassays
mechanism: Use specific binding and calibrated signal detection to estimate selected clinical analytes
operating_requirement: Validated reagents, controls, suitable instruments and trained laboratory staff
consequence: Detect specified targets subject to cross-reactivity and test performance

name: Clinical Culture Susceptibility
mechanism: Compare isolated organisms under standardized laboratory susceptibility conditions
operating_requirement: Qualified containment, culture supplies, reference methods and competent staff
consequence: Inform antimicrobial choice while distinguishing laboratory results from guaranteed clinical response

name: Clinical Specimen Transport
mechanism: Preserve specimen identity and required conditions between collection and analysis
operating_requirement: Appropriate containers, tracked routes, transport capacity and handling staff
consequence: Reduce invalid or misidentified results from delayed or unsuitable transport

name: Diagnostic Accuracy Estimation
mechanism: Compare a test with an appropriate reference while accounting for the tested population
operating_requirement: Representative evidence, defined reference methods and independent analysis
consequence: Expose false positives and negatives before using a test as an automatic decision

name: Clinical Test Probability Updating
mechanism: Update a clinical hypothesis using test evidence and justified starting probabilities
operating_requirement: Competent interpretation and applicable accuracy evidence
consequence: Reduce conclusions drawn from test labels without clinical context

name: Screening Program Evaluation
mechanism: Assess whether testing an apparently unaffected population improves meaningful outcomes after downstream harms
operating_requirement: Follow-up care, population evidence, consent and independent evaluation
consequence: Distinguish beneficial screening from simply detecting more abnormalities

name: Portable Ultrasound Qualification
mechanism: Validate limited bedside imaging tasks for particular operators and devices
operating_requirement: Suitable portable equipment, training, maintenance and image review
consequence: Bring selected imaging questions closer to care without replacing all specialist examinations

name: Doppler Flow Imaging
mechanism: Interpret qualified frequency shifts from moving scatterers to estimate selected flow properties
operating_requirement: Calibrated ultrasound equipment and trained acquisition and interpretation
consequence: Add bounded circulation evidence without assuming exact flow in every geometry

name: Clinical Image Registration
mechanism: Align images using evaluated anatomical correspondences and quantify registration error
operating_requirement: Compatible image data, computation and clinical quality review
consequence: Compare change or plan a procedure while exposing alignment uncertainty

name: Image Guided Intervention Planning
mechanism: Relate an intended intervention path to evaluated images and physical landmarks
operating_requirement: Qualified imaging, clinical team, sterile facilities and appropriate instruments
consequence: Improve selected procedural planning without granting autonomous surgical success

name: Radiotherapy Dose Planning
mechanism: Plan a specified radiation treatment against target and non-target tissue constraints
operating_requirement: Qualified radiation source, calibrated dosimetry, clinical physics and oncology staff
consequence: Deliver only clinically justified treatment within verified planning limits

name: Radiotherapy Delivery Verification
mechanism: Check that positioning and delivered treatment conform to an authorized radiation plan
operating_requirement: Calibrated equipment, independent checks and competent treatment staff
consequence: Detect selected delivery deviations rather than assuming a plan equals treatment

name: Sterile Drug Compounding
mechanism: Prepare qualified patient-appropriate sterile formulations under controlled process conditions
operating_requirement: Appropriate ingredients, clean facilities, trained staff and release checks
consequence: Supply specified preparations while maintaining contamination and identity controls

name: Medicinal Active Fraction Isolation
mechanism: Separate and compare candidate medicinal fractions while tracking composition and observed effects
operating_requirement: Characterized source material, separation equipment, analysts and controlled evidence
consequence: Identify investigational fractions without treating traditional use as proof of safety

name: Medicine Potency Standardization
mechanism: Compare functional or chemical strength against a defined reference with quantified variation
operating_requirement: Suitable reference material, validated assay and quality staff
consequence: Reduce between-batch uncertainty without establishing clinical benefit by itself

name: Oral Dosage Release Design
mechanism: Control and measure release behavior of a defined oral formulation under qualified conditions
operating_requirement: Pharmaceutical ingredients, formulation plant and dissolution testing
consequence: Produce evaluated release profiles rather than guaranteed patient response

name: Medicine Interaction Review
mechanism: Evaluate combined medicine exposure and patient factors against documented interaction evidence
operating_requirement: Complete medicine records, competent review and reliable evidence access
consequence: Identify avoidable treatment conflicts while preserving clinician judgment

name: Medication Reconciliation
mechanism: Resolve discrepancies in actual medicine use across care transitions
operating_requirement: Patient communication, accessible prescriptions and responsible pharmacy or clinical staff
consequence: Reduce omitted, duplicated or conflicting medicine instructions

name: Insulin Product Purification
mechanism: Purify and qualify a specified insulin product for consistent clinical supply
operating_requirement: Suitable biological production source, validated purification, quality staff and required storage
consequence: Make a qualified product available without providing automatic patient treatment

name: Insulin Replacement Services
mechanism: Coordinate indicated insulin replacement with monitoring, education and continuing review
operating_requirement: Actual qualified product, delivery supplies, trained care team and patient support
consequence: Support managed treatment while retaining individual assessment and adverse-event risks

name: Programmable Infusion Pumps
mechanism: Meter a prescribed infusion through qualified programmable delivery and fault detection
operating_requirement: Maintained pump, compatible consumables, power and trained clinical supervision
consequence: Provide controlled delivery with finite supplies and device-error limits

name: Automated Insulin Delivery
mechanism: Coordinate qualified glucose feedback and insulin delivery within a clinically evaluated control system
operating_requirement: Compatible devices, continuing insulin supply, patient training and backup care
consequence: Support bounded glucose management without universal autonomous cure

name: Medical Oxygen Supply Qualification
mechanism: Verify therapeutic oxygen identity and delivery-chain quality at the point of clinical use
operating_requirement: Qualified source, containers or piping, analyzers and maintenance personnel
consequence: Provide a trustworthy oxygen supply rather than equating any gas source with medical service

name: Oxygen Concentrator Services
mechanism: Operate qualified oxygen concentrators against measured output and clinical demand
operating_requirement: Approved equipment, filters, electrical supply, maintenance and clinical staff
consequence: Supply bounded oxygen flow while outages and equipment condition constrain availability

name: Respiratory Support Interfaces
mechanism: Match a qualified respiratory delivery interface to assessed support and monitoring needs
operating_requirement: Suitable consumables, fitted interface and trained clinical assessment
consequence: Deliver an indicated service without assuming every patient needs the same interface

name: Mechanical Ventilation Services
mechanism: Provide monitored qualified mechanical breathing support for indicated conditions
operating_requirement: Maintained ventilator, power, suitable gas supply, consumables and skilled critical-care team
consequence: Support selected respiratory functions with ongoing monitoring and complications

name: Oral Rehydration Services
mechanism: Provide clinically assessed rehydration using qualified oral preparations and follow-up
operating_requirement: Suitable clean water, approved preparations, competent caregivers and referral access
consequence: Address indicated dehydration while exposing cases needing higher care

name: Clinical Nutrition Assessment
mechanism: Relate intake, growth or body change and clinical findings to assessed nutritional needs
operating_requirement: Competent staff, reliable measures, food history and clinical context
consequence: Identify support needs without reducing health to one body measurement

name: Therapeutic Food Services
mechanism: Supply qualified therapeutic foods within an evaluated care and follow-up program
operating_requirement: Suitable products, actual stocks, trained caregivers and complication referral
consequence: Support specified nutrition treatment with finite food and care capacity

name: Enteral Nutrition Services
mechanism: Provide monitored qualified nutritional delivery through an indicated enteral route
operating_requirement: Suitable preparations, delivery equipment, competent staff and hygiene controls
consequence: Support feeding when ordinary intake is insufficient and the route is appropriate

name: Neonatal Feeding Support
mechanism: Assess and assist safe effective newborn feeding with observation of growth and caregiver needs
operating_requirement: Trained supporters, suitable feeding resources and timely referral
consequence: Improve supported feeding without coercing one method or promising universal success

name: Kangaroo Mother Care Services
mechanism: Organize qualified caregiver contact and feeding support for eligible newborns with monitoring
operating_requirement: Willing supported caregivers, trained staff and escalation capacity
consequence: Provide evidence-based supportive neonatal care under defined clinical conditions

name: Antenatal Care Continuity
mechanism: Maintain repeated pregnancy assessment and timely action on changing care needs
operating_requirement: Qualified providers, accessible follow-up, suitable tests and referral capacity
consequence: Support continuing maternal care rather than a single attendance bonus

name: Postpartum Complication Surveillance
mechanism: Recognize and escalate defined changes during post-birth recovery
operating_requirement: Trained caregivers, continuing contact and functioning referral services
consequence: Reduce delays in assessment while retaining limits of available treatment

name: Contraceptive Counseling Services
mechanism: Support informed voluntary choice among suitable evaluated contraceptive options
operating_requirement: Trained counselors, reliable information, privacy and actual selected products or services
consequence: Enable reproductive choice with method-specific limitations and continuing access needs

name: Cervical Screening Followup
mechanism: Connect validated cervical screening results to indicated confirmatory assessment and care
operating_requirement: Qualified testing, accessible follow-up and available clinical treatment capacity
consequence: Reduce losses between screening and care without awarding benefit for testing alone

name: Oral Health Hygiene Practice
mechanism: Maintain and teach evaluated practical oral cleaning with observation of tissue condition
operating_requirement: Suitable cleaning materials, trained instruction and accessible supplies
consequence: Reduce selected preventable oral-health burdens with repeated practice

name: Dental Caries Assessment
mechanism: Assess suspected tooth decay using appropriate examination and qualified diagnostic aids
operating_requirement: Competent oral-health provider, suitable instruments and referral capacity
consequence: Identify indicated preventive or restorative care without equating discoloration with disease

name: Dental Restorative Materials
mechanism: Qualify materials that restore selected tooth structures under oral mechanical and biological conditions
operating_requirement: Approved materials, dental equipment, trained clinicians and quality review
consequence: Support indicated restoration with wear, compatibility and maintenance limits

name: Orthotic Support Design
mechanism: Fit external supports to evaluated movement or alignment needs and monitor their effects
operating_requirement: Qualified orthotic staff, suitable materials, fitting tools and follow-up
consequence: Support selected function while avoiding a universal correction bonus

name: Wheelchair Seating Services
mechanism: Match seating and mobility equipment to assessed posture, propulsion and environment needs
operating_requirement: Appropriate chairs, fitting staff, repair supplies and accessible routes
consequence: Improve usable mobility through individualized fitting and ongoing support

name: Speech Language Rehabilitation
mechanism: Assess and practice specified communication functions using appropriate language and access methods
operating_requirement: Qualified practitioners, accessible materials and repeated supported practice
consequence: Improve or adapt selected communication tasks within individual recovery limits

name: Swallowing Function Services
mechanism: Assess swallowing function and coordinate qualified feeding support or referral
operating_requirement: Competent clinicians, appropriate assessment resources and suitable nutrition support
consequence: Reduce avoidable feeding difficulties without assuming every swallowing problem has one remedy

name: Pressure Injury Prevention
mechanism: Identify tissue-pressure risks and organize qualified positioning, skin observation and support
operating_requirement: Adequate caregivers, suitable support surfaces, hygiene and reassessment
consequence: Reduce selected preventable tissue injury with continuing labor and equipment
